facts.text: Under the Mule Grant, Missouri residents from families with income of $75,000 or less receive tuition assistance at UCM.

sources.title: Mule Grant | University of Central Missouri
sources.quote: Eligibility Requirements * <= $75,000 Income. * Be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident. * FAFSA on File before state of Missouri FAFSA priority deadline (typically Feb 1) * Missouri Resident.
